title: iOS 1.19 — Clearer Skew-T and dewpoint on airport cards
body:
- The Skew-T keeps its proper shape on the phone. Isotherms stay at 45° and the chart centres on the sounding; rotate to landscape for the full temperature range.
- Airport cards and the route graph now show the dewpoint next to the temperature.
- Cross-section: your chosen cloud style now stays put when you switch views. There's also a new experimental air-mass boundary layer under Stability, off by default.
- Refreshing a flight that has already flown now explains why it can't be rebuilt, instead of showing "Access denied".
